g.text: Architectural Evolution from Legacy Linear Compiler to Modern Agentic AI & Neuro-Symbolic Security Platform
Rigid 5-stage pipeline · Strict error aborts · Naive character-count validation
• Reads raw policy character stream (minLength 8, requireUpper true)
• Emits tokens: Identifier, Number, Boolean, Newline, End
• Hard failure on unknown or malformed characters with zero recovery
• Validates policy syntax against grammar: Rule -> Identifier Value
• Throws ParseError immediately on syntax deviations or swapped tokens
• ❌ Aborts entire build immediately; provides NO fix suggestions
• Checks rule names and range boundaries (minLength <= maxLength)
• Uncaught std::invalid_argument crashes on non-numeric lengths
• ❌ Disallows typos; no fuzzy matching or duplicate resolution suggestions
• Converts valid AST rules into flat Constraints data structure
• Checks candidate password against compiled boolean criteria
• Length verification: len >= minLength && len <= maxLength
• Isolated character count checks: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols
Typing "reqiureDigit true" or "requireUpper maybe" aborted the compiler instantly.
"Password123!" passed all checks (12 chars, upper, lower, digit, symbol) despite being #1 leaked.
"P@ssw0rd!" satisfied symbol/digit rules without recognizing the underlying trivial word "password".
Only PASS/FAIL without multi-tier strength scoring or keyboard-first instant execution.
Self-healing parser/semantic AI · Adversarial leetspeak defense · 14-pt scoring
• Strict, high-precision tokenization preserved (no hallucinated tokens)
• Accurate line/column tracking for precise downstream AI diagnostics
• Unqualified std::move clean compilation with 0 warnings
• Inverted Token Recovery: Detects 'true requireDigit' -> repairs to 'requireDigit true'
• Type Heuristic Repair: Flags 'requireUpper maybe' -> suggests standard 'true'
• Emits structured AgentSuggestion with exact source diffs and reasoning
• Levenshtein Typo Repair: 'reqiureDigit' -> calculates distance & suggests 'requireDigit'
• Safe stoi & Deduplication: Catches crashes; suggests removal of duplicate lines
• Adaptive Zero-Trust Hardening: Enforces NIST minLength >= 8 floor safely
• Tri-state constraint system (-1: unset, 0: false, 1: true) for unambiguous logic
• Emits robust generated_validator.cpp C++ executable target
• Static IR Analyzer detects fixed length policies and weak constraint risks
• Unveils disguised dictionary roots beneath affixes

• Multi-tier rating: Very Weak (0-2), Weak, Medium, Strong

• Instant "Return / Enter" Key: Evaluates password on Enter without moving cursor to evaluate button
